tasks.behavior: Editor JPEG/WebP/clipboard export, compare moved/rerouted facts with a Before/Delta/After HTML review, and diagnose --strict as a delivery gate.
acceptance: Export dialog can download JPEG and WebP and copy a PNG to the clipboard from the production editor.
compare reports moved node IDs from layout positions and rerouted edge IDs from port changes, separately from semantic added/removed/changed.
compare can write a Before/Delta/After HTML review that does not invent impact or risk scores.
diagnose --strict exits non-zero when overlap or clipping is present; default diagnose still reports issues with ok:true.
CLI JPEG/WebP stay undocumented as CLI formats; editor-only support is stated in FEATURES/CAPABILITY.
